ssh_key_path.description: Private key to authenticate with. Empty string clears it back to the admin user's key; omitted leaves it unchanged.

write_access.title: Write Access
write_access.description: Whether this grid can now change the catalog's contents.

url.title: Url
url.description: Repository the catalog is now pointed at.

message.title: Message
message.description: Operator-facing outcome.

status.title: Status
status.description: Health check result, e.g. 'ok' when the backend is up and serving requests.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the node's maps can't be listed, when they can't.

file.title: File
file.description: The map's file, as the node's datamap.lua lists it.

map.title: Map
map.description: The map's entry in datamap.lua: {name, messages, when?}.

definition.title: Definition
definition.description: The map's file, as the node holds it.

schemas.title: Schemas
schemas.description: {source, target}: the parts of source.json and target.json the map reads and builds - its messages (tables, structures) and everything they use.

functions.title: Functions
functions.description: The custom.lua functions the map names, and those they call, by name: each one's text.

locals.title: Locals
locals.description: The top-level locals of custom.lua those functions use.

missing_functions.title: Missing Functions
missing_functions.description: Functions the map names that its node didn't define.

samples.title: Samples
samples.description: Sample messages saved with the map ({name, data} each), which the Map view adds when exporting and offers to add to the node when importing. The grid neither adds nor reads them.

files.title: Files
files.description: The node's Lua files as they are now, by path: mapping/datamap.lua, the map's file, custom.lua, premap.lua, postmap.lua and main.lua.

map_file.title: Map File
map_file.description: The map to export: its file, as datamap.lua lists it.

definition_file.title: Definition File
definition_file.description: The receiving node's list of maps.

files.title: Files
files.description: The receiving node's Lua files as they are now, by path.

name.title: Name
name.description: What to call the map; the package's name by default. Made unique among the node's maps.

name.title: Name
name.description: The map's name in this node.

file.title: File
file.description: The map's file in this node.

files.title: Files
files.description: The Lua files to write, by path: mapping/datamap.lua, the map's file and, when it gains functions, custom.lua.

source_schema.title: Source Schema
source_schema.description: source.json to write; null when it needs no change.

target_schema.title: Target Schema
target_schema.description: target.json to write; null when it needs no change.

schema_added.title: Schema Added
schema_added.description: {source, target}: the messages (tables, structures) each schema gains.

functions.title: Functions
functions.description: The functions custom.lua gains, by their names in this node.

renamed.title: Renamed
renamed.description: Functions renamed because this node already has a different one of that name: {old: new}.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: What to check: version differences, schema parts this node defines differently, functions the package lacked.
